Notes

The Efreet are the merciless leaders of the green djinns. Surpassing their lesser brethren both in power and in cruelty, the Efreet are truly terrible opponents who love to use their awesome powers to spread havoc among their enemies or sometimes among their own kind. The disdain they feel towards all other sentient races is second only to the undying hatred they feel towards their blue-skinned relatives, the Marid.

—Tibia Library

Efreets are a higher ranked Green Djinn and are the counterparts of Marids, these strong creatures are usually found in groups with Green Djinn.

Location

Mal'ouquah, Deeper Banuta, Goromas Cult Cave (in the classroom), Magician Quarter, The Arcanum, Djinn Battle island through the Haunted Tomb.

Behaviour

Efreets will make immense damage as they chase their opponents down with their two summons. They are usually not profitable for everyone.

An efreet attacks in melee range. An efreet never retreats.

Strategy

Do not approach Efreets at a low level. They are extremely dangerous and only susceptible to Ice and Holy Damage. Wearing a Dwarven Ring grants you the ability to move freely around the creature. Druids : Hunting Efreets can be a decent hunt (mostly for the Green Piece of Cloth that sells for 2-3k) for Druids, especially above level 80 since Strong Ice Strike was introduced. Beware when you face 2 or more, as you might drop very fast. Sudden Death runes is recommended to carry at all times if you'd be overrun.
